title: 第三章 跟嫂子玩！
content_zh:
湿透的衬衫从身上剥离的时候，凉意让李玉梅的皮肤起了一层细细的栗子，可很快又被体内的燥热驱散了。

    她把衬衫搭在洞壁的一块石头上，又把湿透的裤子也脱了下来，浑身上下只剩下一件贴身的内衣。

    “大壮……”李玉梅的声音微微发颤，对王大壮喊道：“你可以睁开眼了。”

    王大壮睁开眼睛。

    看见了她婀娜的身段，白皙的肌肤，在微弱的光线下泛着一层柔润的光泽。

    她的腰肢纤细得不盈一握，臀部浑圆饱满，双腿笔直修长，那件小小的内衣根本遮不住什么，反而欲盖弥彰，更添了几分撩人的意味。

    换做任何一个正常的男人，看到这一幕恐怕都会血脉偾张。

    可王大壮只是愣了一下，然后歪着头看了看，脸上还是那副憨憨的笑容，眼神干净得像山涧里的泉水，没有一丝杂质。

    李玉梅走上前去，伸出手，握住了王大壮的手。

    然后慢慢地，缓缓地，按在了自己的胸口上。

    王大壮的手掌覆盖在那片柔软之上的瞬间，李玉梅的身体不由自主地颤了一下，像是被电击了一样。

    她咬着下唇，强忍着喉间涌上来的那声呻吟，抬眼望着王大壮。

    “暖不暖和？”

    王大壮眨了眨眼，然后点点头，咧嘴一笑道：“暖和！好舒服！”

    李玉梅的脸更红了，可心里的那团火烧得更旺了。

    她能感觉到他手掌的温度透过那层薄薄的布料传过来，烫得她心口发麻。

    “那……”李玉梅舔了舔有些干涩的嘴唇，声音又低了几分，“那想不想……再摸摸别的地方？”

    王大壮拼命地点头，笑得更开心了，“想！嫂子，还想摸！”

    李玉梅没有再说话。

    她踮起脚尖，双臂环住了王大壮的脖子，把自己贴了上去。

    她感觉到他结实的胸膛贴着她的身体，感觉到他的心跳，砰砰砰的。

    王大壮本能地抱住了李玉梅，把她整个人都圈进了怀里。

    他的动作笨拙而粗野，没有技巧，没有经验，全凭本能在驱使。
content_en:
When the soaked shirt was peeled off her body, the coolness caused a thin layer of chestnuts to appear on Li Youmei's skin, but it was quickly dissipated by the heat in her body.

    She put her shirt on a stone on the cave wall and took off her soaked pants, leaving only her underwear on.

    "Dazhuang..." Li Youmei's voice trembled slightly and she shouted to Wang Dazhuang: "You can open your eyes."

    Wang Dazhuang opened his eyes.

    I saw her graceful figure and fair skin, glowing with a soft luster in the dim light.

    Her waist was so slender that it couldn't fit into one's hand, her buttocks were round and plump, and her legs were straight and slender. That small underwear couldn't cover anything at all, but instead tried to hide it, adding a bit of provocation.

    If it were any normal man, his blood would probably boil when he saw this scene.

    But Wang Dazhuang was just stunned for a moment, and then he tilted his head and looked at it. He still had that naive smile on his face, and his eyes were as clean as the spring water in the mountain stream, without a trace of impurities.

    Li Youmei stepped forward, stretched out her hand, and held Wang Dazhuang's hand.

    Then slowly, slowly, he pressed it on his chest.

    The moment Wang Dazhuang's palm covered the soft piece, Li Youmei's body trembled involuntarily, as if she had been electrocuted.

    She bit her lower lip, holding back the moan that surged up in her throat, and raised her eyes to look at Wang Dazhuang.

    "Is it warm?"

    Wang Dazhuang blinked, then nodded, grinned and said: "Warm! So comfortable!"

    Li Youmei's face turned redder, but the fire in her heart burned even brighter.

    She could feel the warmth of his palm passing through the thin layer of fabric, making her heart feel numb.

    "Then..." Li Youmei licked her dry lips and lowered her voice a little, "Then do you want to... touch other places?"

    Wang Dazhuang nodded desperately and smiled even more happily, "Yes! Sister-in-law, I still want to touch it!"

    Li Youmei said no more.

    She stood on tiptoes, wrapped her arms around Wang Dazhuang's neck, and pressed herself against him.

    She felt his strong chest against her body and felt his heartbeat, pounding.

    Wang Dazhuang instinctively hugged Li Youmei and held her whole body in his arms.

    His movements were clumsy and rough, without skill or experience, driven entirely by instinct.
